title: PDF LAB Workbench phase 4: bounded local live measurement
statement: Adds an optional loopback runner that measures a browser-made two-poem variant with the same MuPDF/Poppler commands the recorded evidence used, under the lab's limits and an empty network namespace, and shows live results beside recorded ones. Proposed for review; runner boundaries are implementation choices, not an accepted arbitrary-upload policy.
conditions: Stacked on PR #30 and PR #29, both unmerged.
Loopback only; accepts only the two-poem fixture family; not a bring-your-own-PDF service.
Network isolation depends on unshare -rn being available on the host and is reported per result.
Checks run locally: typecheck, 30 tests (none skipped), build, 11-check smoke, legacy tests, browser at 1440 and 375.
